sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Pranav Mishra,Sanjay Kumar Om
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.

Heard Shri K.P. Tiwari, counsel for the petitioner, learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondent No.1 and Shri Pranav Mishra for respondent Nos.2 and 3.
2.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding the respondents not to use the land-Arazi No.460, Village Simrawari, Tehsil and District Jhansi for laying water pipeline without formal acquisition under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

3. On 21.02.2024, following order was passed:-
Guljari Lal vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12626392/
1

entities.text: Guljari Lal vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
" 1. Having regard to the nature of controversy, we direct the District Magistrate,
Jhansi to get the site inspected and find out the plot number through which pipeline is being laid by Jal Nigam.
He will also get a site plan prepared after proper survey by a revenue team.
The revenue team will demarcate the plot of the petitioner and also the place through which pipeline is being laid.

The District Magistrate will himself verify whether the survey map is in accordance with the sazra plan of the village or not and will file his affidavit clearly stating whether pipeline is being laid through the land of the petitioner or not.

2. List as fresh on 11 March 2024.
3.
Shri Rajiv Gupta, learned Addl.

Chief Standing Counsel will communicate the instant order to the Collector, Jhansi for proper compliance."
4.
In compliance of the said order, the district administration got the site surveyed by the revenue team.
The District Magistrate has filed his affidavit whereby the survey report has been brought on record.
According to it, the petitioner claims share in Arazi No.460M which is a minjumla number.
There are several other persons who have share in the said plot.
The report mentions that there is a kachcha rasta in existence since last 50-60 years over Plot No.460.
It is not over land in possession of the petitioner but over land in possession of co-sharer Mangal Prajapati.
The said rasta is the only rasta available for accessing the village abadi.
The water pipeline has been laid through the said kachcha rasta.

It is also stated in the affidavit of District Magistrate that the petitioner had filed Suit No.44 of 2005-2006, under Section 229-B of the Uttar Pradesh Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act, 1950 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act) claiming declaration of his title and the said suit was dismissed on 28.12.2007.

entities.text: Uttar Pradesh Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act, 1950
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The appeal filed by the petitioner was also dismissed on 30.07.2012.
The said order has attained finality.
It is, thus, sought to be contended that title of petitioner over the subject land is under cloud and, therefore, even otherwise, he is not entitled to any compensation.
5. In the rejoinder affidavit, there is no denial of the fact that suit under Section 229-B of the Act as well as appeal filed by the petitioner were dismissed.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that a second appeal at the behest of the petitioner is pending before Board of Revenue.
6. It thus emerges that the declaratory suit filed by the petitioner has since been dismissed.
His appeal is pending before Board of Revenue.
The title of the petitioner over the subject land is still not clear.
Moreover, there is a factual dispute as to whether the pipeline has been laid through the land of the petitioner or that of his co-sharer Mangal Prajapati.
We may note that Satish Chandra is also claiming title in the same land and his Writ B No.39101 of 2015 (Satish Chandra vs. The Chairman Board of Revenue and 4 others)

entities.text: Satish Chandra vs. The Chairman Board of Revenue and 4 others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: is pending before this Court, wherein order of status quo passed by this Court is in operation.
7. In the aforesaid facts and circumstances, we are of the opinion that no direction can be issued in exercise of writ jurisdiction for payment of compensation to the petitioner.

We leave it open to the petitioner to avail appropriate remedy, as may be advised to him, in relation to his alleged claim Guljari Lal vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12626392/
2 wherein all questions relating to title in subject land as well as issue as to whether the water pipeline has been laid through the land of the petitioner or other co-sharers would be decided.

entities.text: Guljari Lal vs State Of Up And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 8. The writ petition is disposed of, accordingly.
